27 * On a successful create a single line is written to the dedicated {@code AUDIT} 28 * logger carrying the newly assigned owner id, its customer code, its 29 * registration date and its membership level, so the side-effect can be observed 30 * independently of the REST response. 31 */ 32 @Component 33 public class OwnerCreationAuditLogger { 34 35 private static final Logger AUDIT = LoggerFactory.getLogger("AUDIT"); 36 37 /** 38 * Logs an audit line for the just-created {@code owner}. Call this only after the 39 * owner has been saved so its id and derived fields are populated. 40 * 41 * @param owner the owner that was created 42 */ 43 public void logCreated(Owner owner) { 44 AUDIT.info("Owner created: id={} customerCode={} registrationDate={} membershipLevel={}", 45 owner.getId(), owner.getCustomerCode(), owner.getRegistrationDate(), owner.getMembershipLevel()); 46 } 47 } 48
